civ7-ages-and-crises.purpose: Use as an Age nears its end, during crisis choices, at civilization/Dedication selection, and immediately after entering a new Age.
civ7-ages-and-crises.title: Age transition, civilization choice and crisis response

civ7-combat-and-sieges.purpose: Use for visible engagements, defensive repositioning, attack selection, healing, pillaging or capturing fortified settlements.
civ7-combat-and-sieges.title: Tactical combat, retreat and settlement capture

civ7-commanders-and-logistics.purpose: Use when transporting an army, assigning promotions, deploying packed units, coordinating reinforcements or protecting a Commander.
civ7-commanders-and-logistics.title: Commanders, deployment and reinforcement

civ7-cultural-victory.purpose: Use when evaluating or pursuing Cultural victory to grow the actual Tourism score efficiently while preserving its scoring assets and finish conditions.
civ7-cultural-victory.title: Cultural victory execution

civ7-diplomacy-and-independents.purpose: Use for first contacts, incoming proposals, Independent Power investment, treaties, war preparation or peace negotiation.
civ7-diplomacy-and-independents.title: Diplomacy, Independent Powers and war support

civ7-economic-victory.purpose: Use when evaluating or pursuing Economic victory to build an actual GDP-scoring system rather than merely accumulating a large treasury.
civ7-economic-victory.title: Economic victory execution

civ7-force-planning.purpose: Use before war, when a frontier becomes unsafe, when recruiting reinforcements, or when deciding whether military spending is sufficient.
civ7-force-planning.title: Force planning, recruitment and operational readiness

civ7-growth-and-specialists.purpose: Use at settlement growth decisions or when evaluating whether an urban Specialist is better than developing another rural tile.
civ7-growth-and-specialists.title: Growth allocation and Specialist staffing

civ7-happiness-and-government.purpose: Use when stability changes, selecting a government or celebration, filling policy/tradition slots, or assessing expansion and Specialist maintenance.
civ7-happiness-and-government.title: Happiness, government, policies and celebrations

civ7-military-victory.purpose: Use when evaluating or pursuing Military victory to select territorial objectives that change Dominion while remaining defensible and economically sustainable.
civ7-military-victory.title: Military victory and sustainable territorial dominance

civ7-naval-and-overseas.purpose: Use for coastal defense, ocean reconnaissance, overseas settlement, amphibious attacks or transporting valuable cargo and civilians.
civ7-naval-and-overseas.title: Naval operations and overseas development

civ7-opening-and-expansion.purpose: Use in the first development phase or when deciding whether the empire should expand, stabilize or invest in existing settlements.
civ7-opening-and-expansion.title: Opening priorities and expansion tempo

civ7-production-and-placement.purpose: Use when selecting or changing a settlement queue, buying infrastructure, repairing damage, or placing a building, quarter or Wonder.
civ7-production-and-placement.title: Production, purchasing and building placement

civ7-reconnaissance-and-memory.purpose: Use when exploring, updating enemy sightings, choosing safe routes or deciding which missing information is worth obtaining.
civ7-reconnaissance-and-memory.title: Reconnaissance, uncertainty and map memory

civ7-religion-and-great-works.purpose: Use when selecting a belief, founding or spreading religion, acquiring relics/artifacts/codices, or assigning Great Works to eligible slots.
civ7-religion-and-great-works.title: Beliefs, religious actions and Great Work use

civ7-research-and-civics.purpose: Use when choosing research, evaluating a mastery or unique civic, spending an attribute point, or planning an unlock needed by another skill.
civ7-research-and-civics.title: Technology, civics, masteries and ability choices

civ7-rules-and-capabilities.purpose: Use on attachment, save load, Age transition, game update or unfamiliar choice to establish which rules and tools actually apply.
civ7-rules-and-capabilities.title: Rules, identity and capability calibration

civ7-scientific-victory.purpose: Use when evaluating or pursuing Scientific victory to convert research and production into the actual Innovation and infrastructure requirements.
civ7-scientific-victory.title: Scientific victory execution

civ7-settlement-sites.purpose: Use before founding or redirecting a settler to compare legal sites by development, connectivity, defense and strategic purpose.
civ7-settlement-sites.title: Settlement-site selection

civ7-towns-and-cities.purpose: Use when a Town can specialize or convert, or when rebalancing which settlements supply the empire and which operate production centers.
civ7-towns-and-cities.title: Town focus and City conversion

civ7-trade-and-connections.purpose: Use when connecting settlements, choosing a merchant destination, improving trade access, or diagnosing missing resource and Food benefits.
civ7-trade-and-connections.title: Trade routes and settlement connections

civ7-treasury-and-resources.purpose: Use when spending scarce Gold or Influence, assigning resources, responding to a deficit, or comparing immediate investment with a cash reserve.
civ7-treasury-and-resources.title: Treasury, resource allocation and economic reserves

civ7-triumphs-and-dedications.purpose: Use when choosing optional Age objectives, evaluating a first-to race, claiming a reward or selecting next-Age Dedications.
civ7-triumphs-and-dedications.title: Triumph selection and Dedication value

civ7-turn-management.purpose: Use at every playable turn and after a major state change to resolve blockers, preserve priorities and verify completed actions.
civ7-turn-management.title: Turn management and commitment execution

civ7-victory-monitoring.purpose: Use every turn to inspect enabled finish conditions, detect imminent rival wins and choose whether to continue, pivot or interrupt.
civ7-victory-monitoring.title: Victory monitoring, commitment and denial
